text: First week at the studio. Gerald, my new manager, seems sharp but impatient. The team is lovely, especially Femi who showed me where the good coffee is.
Signed up for the half marathon in the autumn. Twelve weeks of training. Asha laughed and said I'll quit by week three.
Couldn't sleep again. Lay awake replaying the design review. Gerald picked apart my layout in front of everyone and I just nodded.
Jonas reminded me the rent is going up in March. We sat at the kitchen table with a calculator. It's going to be tight.
Ran 5k without stopping for the first time. Slow, ugly, mine. I nearly cried at the end of the canal path.
Asha called with news: she's pregnant! Due in the summer. I'm going to be an aunt. Screamed in the supermarket.
First session with Dr. Lin. Talked mostly about the not sleeping. She asked me to keep a sleep diary for two weeks: bedtime, wake time, how long it takes to drop off.
Gerald talked over me three times in the client meeting. Afterwards Femi said 'that was rough' and bought me a pastry. I felt about two inches tall.
Long run in the rain, 8k. Shins aching. Iced them watching a terrible film with Jonas.
Sleep diary week one: I take about an hour to fall asleep most nights and wake at 4. Dr. Lin wasn't surprised. She thinks it's the phone in bed and the late work emails.
Rent conversation part two. Jonas thinks we should find a cheaper flat further out. I don't want to leave the canal. We left it unresolved and both went quiet.
Presented the new app screens to the whole studio. Gerald actually said 'good work'. Two words. I've been replaying them all day like a song.
Bought a cheap alarm clock so the phone can sleep in the kitchen. Fell asleep in twenty minutes. Suspiciously effective.
Asha's first scan. She sent me the blurry photo and I've made it my lock screen. Mum keeps calling it 'the bean'.
Skipped two training runs this week because of work. Feeling guilty and heavy. Week six and I'm behind.
Jonas and I agreed: we stay, and I'll take on a small freelance job to cover my share of the rent rise. Relief. Hugged him in the hallway.
Dr. Lin and I talked about Gerald today. She said I shrink myself around people who seem disappointed in me and it started long before this job. I cried in her office.
Lisbon! Long weekend with Femi and her cousin. Custard tarts, trams, sunburn. Didn't open my laptop once.
Back from Lisbon to 140 emails and a passive-aggressive message from Gerald about a missed deadline that wasn't mine.
Longest run so far: 16k along the river. Legs like jelly but I could have kept going. Proud of this one.
The freelance job is a bakery's website. Small but sweet. The owner, Rosa, pays in money and croissants.
Bad night. Back to waking at 4 with my heart racing about the redesign deadline. The phone stayed in the kitchen but my brain didn't.
Told Gerald calmly that I need him not to interrupt me in client meetings. He looked surprised, then said 'fair'. My hands were shaking under the desk.
Baby shower planning with Mum for Asha. We argued about the colour scheme for twenty minutes. Settled on yellow. Nobody happy, everybody fine.
Dr. Lin says the sleep is better on paper: fifty minutes more a night on average than in the first diary. Doesn't feel better yet, but the numbers don't lie.
Injured my calf on the hill repeats. Physio says rest for ten days. Half marathon in five weeks. Trying not to panic.
Jonas got the promotion he wanted. We celebrated with cheap prosecco on the roof. Happy for him, a little jealous, mostly happy.
Back running after the calf. Easy 5k. Felt like starting over but at least nothing hurt.
Gerald asked me to lead the bakery chain pitch. Me! Apparently Rosa recommended me after seeing her site. Small world.
Half marathon day. 2:14. Walked twice, cried once, finished. Asha was at the line, enormous and cheering.
Pitch went brilliantly. Gerald took me for lunch and asked what I want to do next year. First real conversation we've had.
Asha had the baby! A girl, Leela, born at 3am. Held her in the afternoon. Tiny fierce face. I'm in love.
Last session with Dr. Lin for now. We looked back at the first sleep diary and laughed. I'm not cured, but I know what helps.
Tired week. Visiting Asha every evening, work busy, no running. Happy-tired rather than sad-tired.
Jonas is thinking of moving in with his girlfriend next year. I said I'm happy for him. I am. I'm also scared about the flat and the rent on my own.
Signed up for a spring marathon. Full one this time. Asha says I'll quit by week three. She said that last time too.
